Definition: a Jizrach (i.e. Ezrachite or Zarchite) or descendant of Zerach
BiblicalUsage: Yizrâch means a Jizrach (that is Ezrachite or Zarchite) or descendant of Zerach. In 1 Chronicles 27:8 we read, "The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand."
TheologicalSignificance: Yizrach is a Jizrach (that is Ezrachite or Zarchite) or descendant of Zerach, and I hold that a small word can carry a large truth when God speaks it.
